facts.value: If pressed_buttons lacks HSD_PAD_B, this callback makes no transition. A B press enters SpecialAirSEnd when ground_or_air equals GA_Air and returns immediately; otherwise it enters SpecialSEnd. Merely holding B is not the tested condition.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported move-lifetime relationship while correcting the claim that this predicate keeps the ghost alive for the full side special.
facts.value: Participates in Fox Illusion/Falco Phantasm ghost-item lifetime by permitting removal once the owner leaves the inclusive SpecialSStart through SpecialAirSEnd motion-state range. Returning false inside that range does not guarantee survival for the entire move: the item also terminates for a missing owner or expiration of its independent ending-state lifetime.

evidence.why: Startup delayed falling and phase-preserving terrain conversion.
Dash completion, pressed-B shortening and terrain conversions with command reset.
Aerial completion request and exceptional ending collision destinations.

facts.rationale: Corrects the overly broad phase-preserving collision explanation by documenting the materially different ending-phase destinations.
facts.value: The move has paired grounded and aerial startup, dash and ending states. Startup and dash collision conversions preserve phase, and dash conversions clear command variable 2. Aerial startup delays falling; dash animation exhaustion enters its matching ending state, while a B press during either dash callback selects ending by actual ground_or_air. Ending collision is asymmetric: grounded End enters ordinary Fall on lost ground, whereas aerial End enters LandingFallSpecial on ground contact and otherwise tries cliff handling. Aerial End animation exhaustion requests the common special-fall entry with move-specific mobility and landing lag.
